RDMA
nodes.description: Remote direct memory access data path for low-latency GPU and storage communication.

nodes.title: RoCE
nodes.description: RDMA over Converged Ethernet, usually discussed with lossless Ethernet and congestion control.

nodes.title: InfiniBand
nodes.description: High-performance network fabric commonly used for GPU clusters and HPC systems.

nodes.title: Clos Fabric
nodes.description: Leaf-spine fabric topology used to scale east-west data center traffic.

nodes.title: BGP
nodes.description: Routing protocol used in underlays, eBGP fabrics, and data center route control.

nodes.title: Congestion Control
nodes.description: Mechanisms that prevent fabric overload, queue buildup, and packet loss.

nodes.title: NUMA
nodes.description: CPU and memory locality model that matters for GPU, NIC, and memory placement.

nodes.title: GPUDirect RDMA
nodes.description: Direct NIC-to-GPU data path that avoids unnecessary CPU memory staging.

nodes.title: NCCL
nodes.description: NVIDIA collective communication library used by distributed GPU training.

nodes.title: Topology-Aware Scheduling
nodes.description: Placement decisions that keep CPUs, memory, NICs, and GPUs close to each other.

nodes.title: KV Cache
nodes.description: Transformer key-value cache used to avoid recomputing attention state during decoding.

nodes.title: Attention
nodes.description: Transformer attention mechanism and its MHA, MQA, GQA, RoPE, and FlashAttention variants.

nodes.title: Quantization
nodes.description: Lower-precision model representation for memory bandwidth and inference efficiency.

nodes.title: Parallelism
nodes.description: Data, tensor, pipeline, and expert parallel strategies for training or serving models.

nodes.title: Checkpointing
nodes.description: Model state persistence and recovery path for training systems.

nodes.title: MLPerf
nodes.description: Benchmark suites for evaluating AI training, inference, and storage systems.
